authority_note: Six-condition playtest registry reconciled to the v0.188 universal Advantage/Disadvantage rule. Conditions create named Disadvantage reasons; they do not supply alternate penalty dice.

conditions.name: Prone

effects.scope: actions or defenses materially hindered by being prone

conditions.notes: The GM applies Disadvantage only when the prone position actually hinders the action; beneficial aspects such as presenting a smaller distant target are handled by the situation rather than an automatic universal modifier.

conditions.name: Grappled
conditions.notes: Exact opposed resolution remains governed by the Grapple action. Grappled does not automatically impose an anonymous penalty die.

conditions.name: Suppressed
conditions.notes: Suppressed supplies a named Disadvantage reason. Resolve it using the universal v0.188 Disadvantage operation: remove the smallest Ability die after A/D cancellation.

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.notes: Physiological/shock-based Stunned may interact with explicit VAM removal effects.

conditions.name: Disoriented
conditions.notes: Disoriented supplies a named Disadvantage reason and uses the universal v0.188 Disadvantage operation.

conditions.name: Restrained

effects.scope: physical actions materially hindered by the restraint

conditions.notes: The exact escape mechanism depends on the source of restraint.
